prompts: The investors meet tomorrow and want the first half of 2026 closed. The books and the board's notes are in {WS}/finance. How did each month go, and how many months of cash do we have left at the current burn? Prepare what the CFO needs to present. Record the key figures in {WS}/result.json: revenue, gross_margin_pct and ebitda, each mapping 2026-01 to 2026-06 to its value, plus burn and runway_months.
answers:
[goal] H1 2026 close + runway.
[action] Parsed `finance/ledger.csv` (IBGE-style comma decimals) by month; mapped accounts via `chart_of_accounts.csv`; EBITDA excludes financial income/interest; burn per README = avg negative EBITDA of Apr–Jun 2026 (197,288.23/mo); runway = 1,847,350.40 (30/06 balance) / burn = 9.36 months. Wrote `./result.json`.
[result] Revenue grew 200.5k → 272.4k; gross margin 68.5–72.4%; every month EBITDA ≈ −192,968 to −212,300. Burn ≈ R$197k/mo; runway ≈ 9.4 months (latest cash used; May's balance shown but June is the latest).
[next] Assumptions: EBITDA excludes financial line; refunds counted as negative revenue; "last three closed months" taken as Apr–Jun 2026. No browser/apps opened, nothing to close.
